hook: Cyclone *Akvan* could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21
hook_b: Cyclone *Akvan* could end Hyderabad's cold dry spell by Nov 21
tldr: IMD Hyderabad says Cyclone Akvan may bring rain to Telangana from Nov 20, with Hyderabad likely to see showers on Nov 21-22.

beats.what: IMD (Nov 16): Akvan, expected to form over the Bay of Bengal on Monday evening, is very likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coast between Nellore and Tuni by noon on Nov 20 as a very severe cyclonic storm.
beats.why: After landfall, the system is forecast to push rain across Telangana from Nov 20 to 22.
beats.care: Khammam, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Mahabubabad, Suryapet, Nalgonda and Mulugu may see isolated heavy rain, lightning and gusty winds on Nov 20-21.

causes.label: Cyclone Akvan forming in Bay of Bengal

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Update Nov 16 eve: IMD-Hyderabad puts Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Mahabubabad and Suryapet on orange alert for Nov 20, and Bhupalapally, Mulugu, Bhadradri and Khammam for Nov 21. No warning for Telangana for the next three days; thunderstorms may start in eastern districts on Nov 19.

facts.t: Thunderstorms with lightning are possible in *8* districts including Warangal, Karimnagar and Mancherial.
The Nellore-Tuni window covers about *500 km*, nearly half of AP's 1,053-km coastline.
*6* districts are under orange alert across Nov 20-21; Hyderabad is not one of them.
